newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean crop 30 pct harvested - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean crop 30 pct harvested - Safras.

text.p: Around 30 percent of Brazil's expected soybean crop had been harvested by March 20, consultants Safras e Mercado said in a weekly report.
The 30 percent compares with 19 percent by March 21, 1996, and an historical average over the past five years of 17 percent, it added.

In the week ending March 20, the return of rains did not impede the progress of the harvest. With conditions continuing favorable in most areas, there are no apparent reasons to change production estimates.
The only exception is the relatively dry situation in Rio Grande do Sul where there have not been plentiful rains in the past two weeks.
Good accumulated water reserves should have however avoided any losses in yield so far but substantial rains will be needed in the near future before losses will begin to be registered, Safras said.
